reviews.author: Harry Yoo
reviews.summary: Approved the two patches in the series, specifically praising the consolidation of promo vs. high watermark checks in vmscan.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 10:18:28AM -0800, Joshua Hahn wrote:
> There are three sites which all check the watermark that kswapd reclaims
> zones up to, which is the promo watermark when NUMA balancing memory
> tiering is enabled, and the high watermark otherwise.
> 
> Consolidate the pattern into an inline helper and move the dependency
> on the sysctl.h header into page_alloc.h.
> 
> No functional changes intended.
> 
> Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>
> Reviewed-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>
> Reviewed-by: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
> Reviewed-by: Dev Jain <dev.jain@arm.com>
> Tested-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Signed-off-by: Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com>
> ---

Looks good to me,
Reviewed-by: Harry Yoo (Meta) <harry@kernel.org>

-- 
Cheers,
Harry / Hyeonggon

reviews.author: Harry Yoo
reviews.summary: Approved the first patch in the series, specifically praising the introduction of a helper function for kswapd node skip checks.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 10:18:27AM -0800, Joshua Hahn wrote:
> get_page_from_freelist() checks many conditions for each zone, often
> with a big comment block explaining the conditions.
> 
> Move the kswapd check and its comment into should_skip_kswapd_zone() to
> make the zone iteration cleaner to read.
> 
> While moving this, also resolve a checkpatch warning which complains of
> a waitqueue_active() call with no corresponding comment explaining why
> the lockless use is OK in this case.
> 
> No functional change intended.
> 
> Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>
> Reviewed-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>
> Reviewed-by: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
> Reviewed-by: Dev Jain <dev.jain@arm.com>
> Tested-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Signed-off-by: Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com>
> ---

Looks good to me,
Reviewed-by: Harry Yoo (Meta) <harry@kernel.org>

-- 
Cheers,
Harry / Hyeonggon

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the get_page_from_freelist function in mm/page_alloc by introducing a helper function for kswapd node skip checks and consolidating promo vs. high watermark checks in vmscan.
